description: scriptconv's Epitran backend (Phonemizer.EPITRAN), the multilingual rule-based orthography->IPA mapper. get_ipa('casa','pt-PT')=='kɐzɐ', get_ipa('obrigado','pt-PT')=='obʁiɡɐdo' - genuine rule-based conversion, verified on 3 pt-PT samples ('mundo'->'mundo' is a coincidental identity match, 'casa'/'obrigado' are not).
notes: Verified working for pt-PT in the shared venv (epitran + lex_lookup warning is benign - flite's lex_lookup binary is only used as an optional fallback). en-US SKIPPED: raised OutOfVocabulary (empty phonemization) for 'hello' - epitran's default en config did not resolve. PROVENANCE: epitran-family output is a rule-based tool, not human-reviewed - competes fine as a fighter, but per this repo's provenance-tier convention must never be used as a gold/reference source for future g2p datasets.
